caption:
Danced through the whole set, then woke up feeling it in your back and feet? Momo knows the feeling. 🎶

Standing in one spot for hours is surprisingly hard work. Walking spreads the load around, but stillness keeps the same muscles busy, so backs, hips and feet often feel it most.

Shift your weight every few minutes, wear supportive shoes you've already broken in, keep your bag light and sit between sets when you can. Most next-day stiffness settles within a day or two, and a gentle walk usually helps more than the couch.

Still stiff after a few days? Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can take a look. Book online via the link in bio.
